title: Graph
summary: A graph records objects and pairwise connections while discarding most other detail.

content.plain: A graph records objects and pairwise connections while discarding most other detail.
content.exact: A simple undirected graph is G=(V,E) with E⊆{{u,v}:u,v∈V,u≠v}; directed and weighted graphs require extended data.
content.example: A road map can be abstracted to junction vertices and road edges.
content.caveat: A plotted function and a graph-theoretic graph are different uses of the word.
